English: <<The face that peers through a straggle of hair is a picture of incomprehension and suspicion, suddenly breaking into an unexpected, gap-toothed smile of amazement.>>
Chinese: <<从乱发间窥出的那张脸,写满不解与疑虑,随即突然绽开一个出人意料的、缺牙豁齿的惊喜笑容。>>

English: Come closer, there. I'm hardly going to kill the first conversation partner I've had in thirty years.##Let me ((look)) at you.
Chinese: 来,走近点。三十年来的第一个说话对象,我可舍不得杀。##让我((看看))你。

English: You are ((real)), aren't you?##Not another entropic discharge of the [[sphere]]?
Chinese: 你是((真的)),对吧?##不是[[球体]]又一次熵放电弄出来的?

English: Well, you certainly wouldn't be the first case of it...
Chinese: 嗯,你绝不是第一例……

English: Still, you ((seem)) real. So do I, most of the time. My name is [[Rasmussen]].
Chinese: 不过,你((看起来))是真的。我也一样,大多数时候。我叫[[拉斯穆森]]。

English: Some days - some years -  I wonder. But let's assume I am.##My name is [[Rasmussen]].
Chinese: 有些日子——有些年头——我也怀疑。但就当我真的是吧。##我叫[[拉斯穆森]]。

English: Well, you look fairly real. Yes, welcome.##My name is [[Rasmussen]].
Chinese: 嗯,你看起来相当真实。好,欢迎。##我叫[[拉斯穆森]]。

English: <<As he comes closer, you can see that Rasmussen's clothing, ragged as it is, was once a resplendent set of Old Emberian robes: or rather, many sets, now seemingly all patched and darned together into a single bizarre ensemble.>>
Chinese: <<他走近时,你能看出拉斯穆森的衣裳虽然破烂,却曾是一套华丽的古余烬长袍:或者说,是好几套,如今似乎全被缝补拼凑成一身古怪的行头。>>

English: You really are real...##I was so sure we were all going to die out before anyone came back.
Chinese: 你真的是真的……##我一直确信,在有人回来之前,我们全都得死绝。

English: I thought we were all going to die out before anyone came back.
Chinese: 我还以为,在有人回来之前,我们全都得死绝。

English: This is...well, it doesn't really have a name. This is just...where we ended up.
Chinese: 这里……嗯,其实没有名字。这里只是……我们最终落脚的地方。

English: We, the [[Rasmussen clan]]. My ancestors. The ones who built the [[ship]] you've no doubt spotted, right on top of us here.
Chinese: 我们,[[拉斯穆森家族]]。我的祖先。就是造了那艘[[飞船]]的人,你一定已经看见了,就在我们头顶。

English: Oh, going on forty years now, since my parents died. I think that's right, at least, it's a bit hard to keep track.##We've been here - the family, I mean - since... well, since everything, really. Long before I was born.
Chinese: 哦,我父母去世快四十年了。我想没错,至少,时间实在不太好算。##我们在这里——我是说这个家族——自从……嗯,自从那件事以来。早在我出生之前。

English: You know! You know about it! Knowledge still endures. Yes. Yes, indeed.
Chinese: 你知道!你知道那件事!知识还在延续。好。好,太好了。

English: I should ask how you found me, I suppose, but I have so many more interesting questions! So many things I've heard about the world out there...##My grandfather told me you all live inside giant mushrooms: don't they get a bit smelly? Do you still have snakes? I always wanted a pet snake.
Chinese: 我本该问问你是怎么找到我的,但我有太多更有意思的问题!外面世界的传闻我听了那么多……##我祖父说你们都住在巨型蘑菇里:那不会有点臭吗?你们还有蛇吗?我一直想要一条宠物蛇。

English: But where are my manners? Excuse me, it's been thirty years since I needed them. My questions can wait: you must have questions for ((me)).
Chinese: 不过我这是失礼了?抱歉,我已经三十年用不上礼数了。我的问题可以等:你一定有问题要问((我))。

English: I was trying to explain to you, wasn't I... This is...was...is our home. It was never meant to be. But the Rasmussens, we...
Chinese: 我正要跟你解释来着……这里是……曾是……就是我们的家。这从来不是命中注定。但拉斯穆森家,我们……

English: Gladly! Well, now. My eight-greats-grandmother was an engineer. An impossibly good one.##When she was young, she became convinced that some terrible cataclysm was coming, and she built a ship to take us away, a new engine that could outrun the destruction.
Chinese: 乐意之至!好,是这样。我的八世曾祖母是位工程师。好得不可思议的那种。##她年轻时,就确信一场可怕的浩劫即将来临,于是造了一艘带我们远走高飞的船,一台能跑赢毁灭的新引擎。

English: It...it almost worked. We escaped. But though the engine was a wonder, something went wrong with the steering, and instead of getting all the way away, the ship foundered, crashed, here.
Chinese: 它……它差点就成功了。我们逃出来了。但引擎虽是奇迹,操舵却出了岔子,船没能彻底远离,半途失事,坠毁在这里。

English: My ancestors scavenged from the ship, tore it to pieces and reassembled it, used the [[engine]] for protection instead of propulsion.##It would fry any big ship that got near, and after a while they just stopped trying. Most likely people got scared. Until...well. Until now.
Chinese: 我的祖先从船上拆解物资,把它拆成零件重新组装,让[[引擎]]从推进之用改为护佑之用。##任何靠近的大船都会被烧成焦炭,久而久之,就再没人尝试了。多半是人们吓怕了。直到……嗯。直到现在。

English: And so we've been here ever since. Just us. And now...now I'm the only one, the only one at all.##The last Rasmussen.
Chinese: 于是我们从那时起就守在这里。只有我们。而现在……现在只剩我一个,孤零零一个。##最后的拉斯穆森。

English: I have been...hoping that someone might come, while I still could speak with them.##I imagine you want to know more about the engine, though.
Chinese: 我一直……盼着能有人来,趁我还能与人交谈。##不过,我猜你想多了解一些引擎的事。

English: Ah, right. Yes, I suppose I...I suppose that's to be expected.
Chinese: 啊,对。是啊,我想我……我想这也是意料之中。

English: The engine was - is - revolutionary. It still works, you know. I'm the only one maintaining it now. But I don't know what I'm maintaining it ((for)) anymore.
Chinese: 那台引擎曾经——如今也是——革命性的。它还能运转,你知道吗。现在只有我一个人在维护它。但我已经不知道自己维护它((为了什么))。

English: In any case, the engine works. It's up there, up in the [[wreck]] of the ship, though without anything to do it just puts out more and more energy.##But you could [[remove it]], if you wanted. That's what you came for, isn't it?
Chinese: 反正引擎还在运转。就在上面,在飞船的[[残骸]]里,只是无事可做,它输出的能量越来越多。##不过,如果你愿意,可以[[把它拆走]]。你就是为这个来的,不是吗?

English: Don't worry. I know you didn't come here just to listen to me.
Chinese: 别担心。我知道你不是专程来听我唠叨的。

English: The [[sphere]] is up above, but you won't be able to reach it just like that. It puts out too much energy to get close to it.##But there is a way to shut it off - two [[switches]], elsewhere on the island, separate from each other. Failsafes.
Chinese: [[球体]]就在上面,但你没法直接够到它。它输出的能量太大,根本没法靠近。##不过有个办法能关掉它——岛上有两个[[开关]],彼此分开。保险装置。

English: If you can switch them both, the [[sphere]] will disconnect.##You'll be able to get it out, move it.
Chinese: 若你能把两个都扳下,[[球体]]就会断开。##你就能把它取出来,搬走。

English: I...yes. Off you go. Only...come back one more time, won't you? Before you leave?
Chinese: 我……好。去吧。只是……走之前,再回来看我一次,好吗?

English: What, you think I'm going to stop you? You think I could even try?
Chinese: 怎么,你以为我会拦你?你以为我拦得住?

English: And in any case, what is it doing here, now? Protecting me? From what?
Chinese: 再说,如今它守在这里做什么?保护我?防什么?

English: And when I'm gone, it will be protecting nothing at all.##No. Much better that it goes back to its original purpose.
Chinese: 等我走了,它保护的就什么都不是了。##不。让它回归最初的使命,好得多。

English: Well then, you already know what you're about! If you can find the other, you'll be home and dry.
Chinese: 那么好,你已经知道该怎么做了!只要找到另一个,就大功告成。

English: <<He smiles, a little sadly.>> ## I suspected as much. Forgive an old man his little conversational indulgence, will you? I just wanted to hear another voice for a while.
Chinese: <<他笑了,带着一丝伤感。>>##我就猜到是这样。原谅老人家这点谈话的贪恋,好吗?我只是想多听一会儿另一个人的声音。

English: You can go on now, up into the ship. The sphere is there.
Chinese: 你现在可以上去了,进到飞船里。球体就在那儿。

English: Oh, you're back. I'm not used to all this conversation, you know. Did I already mention that? I did? Proves my point.##What was it you needed?
Chinese: 哦,你回来了。你知道,我不习惯这么多交谈。我说过吗?说过?这就证明了我的话。##你需要什么?

English: Gladly! Gladly. I've had a bit of time to practice, you might say.##Well, now. The Rasmussen family. Family, clan, corporation, whathaveyou, they were all of those things: a line of engineers and shipwrights.
Chinese: 乐意之至!乐意之至。你可以说,我有的是练习机会。##好,那么。拉斯穆森家族。家族、宗族、商号,随你怎么叫,他们全都当过:一族工程师和造船匠。

English: My eight-greats-grandmother was a particularly gifted engineer.##It's said she saw machines in her dreams: machines, and other things too.
Chinese: 我的八世曾祖母是位天赋异禀的工程师。##据说她能在梦里看见机器:机器,还有别的东西。

English: When she was young, she saw something coming in those dreams, something dreadful. [[The Shattering]], we always called it.##She saw a terrible destruction coming, so she took her most advanced designs, the ones that were going to put the Rasmussens head and shoulders above their competitors once and for all, and she turned the blueprints into a plan for an escape craft instead.
Chinese: 她年轻时,在那些梦里看见有什么正在逼近,可怕的东西。[[大破碎]],我们一直这么叫它。##她看见一场可怕的毁灭正在到来,于是拿起她最先进的设计——那些本要让拉斯穆森家彻底压倒所有对手的设计——把图纸改成了一艘逃生飞船的方案。

English: It...it almost worked. It did work. We escaped, we lived. The Rasmussens built themselves an engine, and an ark around it, and they lifted off just in time, the whole family.##But - this is the way my grandfather told it, at least, though we never much liked to talk about just what happened - though the engine was a wonder, something went wrong with the steering.
Chinese: 它……它差点就成了。它成了。我们逃了出来,活了下来。拉斯穆森家造出了引擎,又围着引擎造了一艘方舟,全家及时起飞。##但——至少我祖父是这么讲的,虽然我们向来不太爱谈到底发生了什么——引擎虽是奇迹,操舵却出了岔子。

English: Instead of getting all the way away, the ship foundered, crashed, here. Far enough away to escape the Shattering...and far enough away never to reach the world again.
Chinese: 船没能彻底远离,半途失事,坠毁在这里。远得足以逃过大破碎……也远得永远回不到人世。

English: My ancestors guessed that something had survived in the rest of the world. We saw ships, sometimes, but nothing came near, and we had no way to get back, and in time...in time, that became the way they liked it.
Chinese: 我的祖先猜到世上别处还有幸存者。我们偶尔看见船只,但从没有谁靠近,我们也回不去,久而久之……久而久之,这就成了他们喜欢的方式。

English: Yes. Here I still am.
Chinese: 是啊。我还在这儿。

English: We - they, my ancestors, forgive me, they always seem very...present. They scavenged the ship, tore it to pieces and reassembled it, used the engine for protection instead of propulsion.##In time we came to fear the idea of anyone coming near, but they never did. Until...well. Until now.
Chinese: 我们——他们,我的祖先,原谅我,他们似乎总是……近在眼前。他们拆解飞船,拆成零件重新组装,让引擎从推进之用改为护佑之用。##久而久之,我们害怕有人靠近的念头,但从没有人来。直到……嗯。直到现在。

English: And so we've been here ever since. Just us.##That grandfather I just mentioned...he was my only one. I think most people have more than that. And now...now I'm the only one, the only one at all. The last Rasmussen.
Chinese: 于是我们从那时起就守在这里。只有我们。##我刚才说的那位祖父……他是我唯一的祖父。我想大多数人不止一个。而现在……现在只剩我一个,孤零零一个。最后的拉斯穆森。

English: I have been...hoping that someone might come, while I still could speak with them. Thank you, for letting me tell my story.
Chinese: 我一直……盼着能有人来,趁我还能与人交谈。谢谢你,听我讲完我的故事。

English: The [[engine]] is - was - revolutionary. The heart of it is what we called the [[Rasmussen Sphere]]##It's a kind of energy recursion sink, it repackages the natural entropy of a normal engine system into...well, into more energy. Don't ask me how.
Chinese: 那台[[引擎]]曾经——如今也是——革命性的。它的心脏就是我们所说的[[拉斯穆森球体]]##它是一种能量递归汇,把普通引擎系统天然的熵……重新打包成,嗯,更多能量。别问我原理。

English: My grandparents claimed they understood: by my parents' time nobody was sure anymore.##I haven't been up there for years now, but they taught me how to work all the controls, even if I couldn't quite tell you what makes it tick.
Chinese: 我的祖辈声称自己明白:到了我父母那辈,已经没人确定了。##我好些年没上去了,但他们教会过我操作所有的控制装置,尽管我说不清它到底怎么运作。

English: But you could remove it, if you wanted. That's what you came for, isn't it? Don't worry. I know you didn't come to listen to me.##The sphere is up there, in the wreck, but you won't be able to reach it just like that. It puts out too much energy.
Chinese: 但你可以把它拆走,只要你想。你就是为这个来的,不是吗?别担心。我知道你不是来听我唠叨的。##球体就在上面,在残骸里,但你没法直接够到它。它输出的能量太大。

English: There is a way to shut it off - two switches, elsewhere on the island, separate from each other. Failsafes. If you can switch them both, the sphere will disconnect. The energy will still be there, but you'll be able to get it out, move it.
Chinese: 有个办法能关掉它——两个开关,在岛上别处,彼此分开。保险装置。你若能把两个都扳下,球体就会断开。能量还在,但你就能把它取出来,搬走了。

English: It's done. You don't need to tell me, I can feel it. Or rather I can't feel it, can't feel the energy anymore.##Hm. Well done. That damned thing has sat in one place for centuries.
Chinese: 办成了。你不用说,我感觉得到。或者说,我感觉不到了,再也感觉不到那股能量。##嗯。干得好。那该死的东西在一个地方蹲了几百年。

English: Time for it to fly again. Time for it to do what the Rasmussens meant it to do in the first place.
Chinese: 该让它重新飞了。该让它做拉斯穆森家当初造它的本意了。

English: Ach, and what would I do then? There's nothing for me out there. I hoped to live long enough for someone to come with a few kind words for me, and they have. That's enough for me.##Leave me here, and I'll join my ancestors soon enough. Go. Use it well.
Chinese: 唉,我出去又能做什么?外面没有属于我的东西。我只想活到有人带着几句好话来找我,而他们来了。这就够了。##把我留在这儿吧,我很快就会去见祖先。走吧。好好用它。

English: Goodbye to you, then. Fly fast. Remember the Rasmussens.
Chinese: 那么再见了。飞快一点。记住拉斯穆森家。

English: Who's there? Who's that? I felt...I feel...nothing. It's gone.
Chinese: 谁在那儿?那是谁?我感觉……我感觉……没了。它没了。

English: Have you got it? The [[Rasmussen Sphere]]. The work of my ancestors?
Chinese: 你拿到了吗?[[拉斯穆森球体]]。我祖先的杰作?

English: Ah, what's the point in explaining it all. You've got it now, and without my help. You don't need an old man wittering on.##Go on, go.
Chinese: 唉,解释这一切又有什么意义。你已经拿到手了,没靠我的帮助。你不需要一个老头子絮絮叨叨。##去吧,走吧。

English: Need anything else?
Chinese: 还需要别的吗?

English: That's... the first time I've been accused of that.
Chinese: 这还是……头一回有人这么怀疑我。

English: I'm real. Are you?
Chinese: 我是真的。你呢?

English: <<Say nothing as you approach.>>
Chinese: <<一言不发地走近。>>

English: Who exactly is dying out?
Chinese: 到底谁要死绝了?

English: What is this place?
Chinese: 这是什么地方?

English: You've been here alone for how long, exactly?
Chinese: 你一个人在这儿待了多久,确切说?

English: I'm here looking for...an engine? A sphere, I was told?
Chinese: 我来找……一台引擎?别人跟我说是个球体?

English: I'm sorry, I don't understand. You'll have to explain.
Chinese: 抱歉,我没听懂。你得解释一下。

English: Never mind all that. Tell me about the engine.
Chinese: 这些先不提。跟我说说那台引擎。

English: Right. Off I go then.
Chinese: 好。那我去了。

English: You really don't mind if I remove it? What will happen to you?
Chinese: 我把它拆走,你真的不介意?你怎么办?

English: I think I've already deactivated one of those switches.
Chinese: 我想我已经关掉其中一个开关了。

English: I've found those already: they're both shut off.
Chinese: 那两个我已经找到了:都关掉了。

English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Tell me about your family again, the Rasmussens.
Chinese: 再跟我讲讲你的家族,拉斯穆森家。

English: I see. And here you still are.
Chinese: 我明白了。而你还在这里。

English: Go on...
Chinese: 接着说……

English: Tell me about the sphere again.
Chinese: 再跟我说说那个球体。

English: I can take you with me, take you off this island.
Chinese: 我可以带你走,带你离开这座岛。

English: I will use it well.
Chinese: 我会好好用它。

English: <<A large breaker-like [[switch]] is set into a console before you.>>##<<The whole thing, and the hut around it, seemed to have been put together from a haphazard, if impressive, selection of parts which are now showing their age.>>
Chinese: <<一个巨大的断路器般的[[开关]]嵌在你面前的控制台上。>>##<<这整套东西,连同它周围的小屋,似乎是用一批杂乱却精良的零件拼凑而成,如今都已显出年月。>>

English: <<The console has a single large switch, like a breaker.>>##<<Like the hut itself, the console looks both makeshift and ancient, ramshackle and high-tech: an inelegantly botched-together selection of elegant components, rust blossoming from the cracks between the parts.>>
Chinese: <<控制台上只有一个巨大的断路器式开关。>>##<<和小屋本身一样,这控制台既简陋又古老,既破败又高科技:一堆精美零件笨拙地拼在一起,部件间的缝隙里锈迹绽放。>>

English: <<The switch is stiff, moving only with a grinding sound.>>##<<When it thuds back into the device, there is no immediate change anywhere around you.>>
Chinese: <<开关很涩,伴随着摩擦声才勉强扳动。>>##<<当它哐地落回装置中,你周围没有任何立时的变化。>>

English: <<The switch is badly rusted, but comes loose with force.>>##<<As it clicks home, you hear...nothing, ringing in your ears: the strange echoing silence of a sound that you hadn't been hearing stopping suddenly, and true silence rushing in across the island.>>
Chinese: <<开关锈得厉害,但用力便能扳动。>>##<<当它咔哒归位,你耳中响起的是……一片空无:某种你未曾察觉的声音骤然停止,真正的寂静漫过整座岛。>>

English: <<Now that it is shut off, there is nothing further to be done with the device.>>
Chinese: <<既然已经关掉,这装置便再无事可做。>>

English: Flick the switch
Chinese: 扳动开关

English: Leave it
Chinese: 离开

English: <<The man inside the shell is as gnarled as his clutter-filled home. He gives you a hard, silent stare, almost as if he is seeing through you to something on the other side.>>
Chinese: <<壳中的男人和他堆满杂物的家一样虬结苍老。他给你一个僵硬的、无声的凝视,仿佛正透过你,看着你身后的什么东西。>>

English: %%The man's gaze flicks away from you, his eyes focusing behind you for a moment before he turns his back. The dismissal, for all its silence, couldn't be clearer.
Chinese: %%男人的目光从你身上移开,在你身后聚焦了片刻,随即转过身去。虽然一言不发,这份逐客之意再明白不过。

English: %%Ah. A visitor.##But... a visitor for me?
Chinese: %%啊。访客。##但……是来找我的访客?

English: As much as the dead above live on the field of the fallen, I suppose. Yes, I spend my time here, and at times other spend their gold here.
Chinese: 我想,就像上面的死者活在阵亡之地一样吧。是的,我在这里消磨时光,有时别人也在这里消磨金币。

English: This place? My home, my emporium, my steed.
Chinese: 这个地方?我的家,我的商场,我的坐骑。

English: Or did you mean the field of slaughter up above?##[[Aristide's Rock]], they used to call it.
Chinese: 还是指上面那片屠宰场?##[[亚里士提德之岩]],人们从前这么叫它。

English: Among other things... these days I seldom encounter others. But I retain a number of curios and trinkets here.##You may find I have some [[items of considerable interest]]...
Chinese: 除了别的……这些日子我很少遇到旁人。但我在这里存着不少珍玩和小物件。##或许你会发现我有几件[[颇有趣味的货品]]……

English: I'm not here on business, I'm... shall we say, paying my respects? But I'm always happy to do a little trading on the side. You may find I have some [[items of interest]]...
Chinese: 我不是来办事的,我……这么说吧,是来致敬的?但我向来乐意顺带做点小买卖。或许你会发现我有几件[[有趣的货品]]……

English: To the dead outside, of course. The fallen soldiers, and the... other dead.
Chinese: 当然是给外面的死者。阵亡的士兵,还有……别的死者。

English: The Inquisition might want us to forget what happened here, but we haven't all, not yet.##And nor have the dead.
Chinese: 宗教裁判所或许想让我们忘掉这里发生过什么,但我们没有全都忘,还没有。##死者也没有。

English: So you've returned. These days I seldom encounter others.##I retain a number of curios and trinkets here. You may find I have some [[items of considerable interest]]...
Chinese: 你回来了啊。这些日子我很少遇到旁人。##我在这里存着不少珍玩和小物件。或许你会发现我有几件[[颇有趣味的货品]]……

English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: Leave him to his own devices
Chinese: 由他去吧

English: @@What is this place?
Chinese: @@这是什么地方?

English: Emporium? So this is a shop?
Chinese: 商场?所以这是家店?

English: Certainly, let me see what you've got. <<[TRADE]>>
Chinese: 当然,让我看看你有什么。<<[交易]>>

English: What are you doing out here? There don't seem to be many customers.
Chinese: 你在这儿做什么?似乎没多少客人。

English: Paying your respects? To whom?
Chinese: 致敬?向谁?

English: I see. Well, shall we trade? [TRADE]
Chinese: 我明白了。那么,做买卖吗?[交易]

English: I see. I'll be going, then.
Chinese: 明白了。那我走了。

English: Another time, maybe.
Chinese: 或许下次吧。

English: Ach, don't be shy. <<He puffs on his pipe, dispersing a peculiar odour.>> ## It's my own invention, if you're curious. Seventeen times more efficient than a normal pipe. A single pouch used to last me months in the field!
Chinese: 哎呀,别害羞。<<他抽着烟斗,散出一股奇特的气味。>>##你要是好奇,这是我自己发明的。效率是普通烟斗的十七倍。战地上一袋烟丝够我用好几个月!

English: Ah, you again? <<The old veteran puffs on his mechanical pipe, half-hidden by baroque swirls of smoke.>>
Chinese: 啊,又是你?<<老兵抽着他那支机械烟斗,半掩在巴洛克式的烟雾旋涡里。>>

English: <<The man in the corner has the most spectacular mustachioes you have ever seen, ones to make a walrus weep with envy: from beneath them protrudes an indescribable device that might be the distant descendant of a pipe. His bearing is stiff, dignified, even as he sits alone; several empty glasses in front of him.>>
Chinese: <<角落里的男人蓄着你生平仅见的最壮观的八字胡,能让海象嫉妒落泪:胡子底下伸出一个难以名状的装置,或许是烟斗的远房子孙。他仪态僵硬而威严,即使独坐也是如此;面前摆着几只空杯。>>

English: Ach, don't be shy. <<He puffs on his pipe, dispersing a peculiar odour.>> ## It's my own invention, if you're curious. Recycles the tobacco juice and vaporises it back through the system for further consumption. Seventeen times more efficient than a normal pipe.
Chinese: 哎呀,别害羞。<<他抽着烟斗,散出一股奇特的气味。>>##你要是好奇,这是我自己发明的。回收烟汁,重新汽化,再送回系统里继续享用。效率是普通烟斗的十七倍。

English: <<He lets out a wheezing chuckle.>> Imagine the savings! A single pouch used to last me months in the field.
Chinese: <<他发出喘息般的轻笑。>>想想能省多少!战地上一袋烟丝够我用好几个月。

English: And to you.
Chinese: 你也是。

English: Pah! Certainly not. You think a common soldier could have designed this? <<He waggles his mechanical pipe.>>
Chinese: 呸!当然不是。你以为普通士兵能设计出这玩意?<<他晃了晃他的机械烟斗。>>

English: I was a combat engineer. Lieutenant-Artificer Drangorg, 17th Greaseguards. Building and maintaining engines of war the likes of which you couldn't imagine.
Chinese: 我曾是战斗工程师。第十七润滑卫队技师中尉德兰戈格。建造和维修你想象不到的战争机器。

English: Of course in the God War! You don't need a four-storey war engine to hunt poachers who've been taking too many rabbits, do you? No, we built machines to take the fight to the gods themselves. And we won.
Chinese: 当然是神之战!难道猎几个偷兔子的偷猎者还需要四层楼高的战争机器?不,我们造机器,是要跟诸神本人开战。而且我们赢了。

English: The kinds of things that'll kill a god stone dead, that's what. War machines like moving mountains. Works of craft and science like you never see nowadays.
Chinese: 就是能一击打死神的玩意儿。像会移动的山一样的战争机器。如今再也见不到的工艺与科学杰作。

English: We saw action at The Battle of the Gates, as well as Black Restday; the retreat from Krasnagrad, the siege of Aunpur... <<He sees your eyes glaze over.>> ##These are all just names to you, aren't they? If that.
Chinese: 我们打过诸门之战,还有黑色休日;克拉斯纳格勒撤退、奥恩普尔围城……<<他看见你眼神发直。>>##这些对你来说不过是几个名字,对吧?连名字都算不上。

English: Well, how 'bout ((The Battle of Aristide's Rock?)) You ((must'a)) heard that one.
Chinese: 那,((亚里士提德之岩之战))怎么样?这个你((肯定))听说过。

English: Pah! You can bloody well ((see)) the damned place from here! It's that isle to the North, past Pwyll, with a busted up [[engine of war]] - you ((can't)) miss it.
Chinese: 呸!从这里你((看))都看得见那该死的地方!就是北边那座岛,过了普威尔,有台报废的[[战争机器]]——你((不会))看不见的。

English: Of course ye have!##You can bloody well ((see)) the busted up [[engine of war]] if you look North, past Pwyll.
Chinese: 你当然听说过!##朝北边看,过了普威尔,你((看))都看得见那台报废的[[战争机器]]。

English: The war was almost over when we fought there, but that's the one that sticks with me. The one where I left behind... well...##<<He sighs.>> You want to hear an old soldier's ramblings or not?
Chinese: 我们在那儿打仗时,战争已近尾声,但偏偏是那一仗最让我难忘。就是那一仗,我抛下了……唉……##<<他叹息。>>你到底想不想听一个老兵的絮叨?

English: Aye, fair enough. Well, anythin' else you want to chin-wag about?
Chinese: 是啊,也是。那么,还有什么想聊的?

English: Hm, well, the war was almost over by the time we got to Aristide's Rock. No place at all, really, but some of them believers fled there with a god. ((On)) a god, in fact.
Chinese: 嗯,我们到亚里士提德之岩时,战争已近尾声。那地方其实什么都没有,只是一些信徒带着一位神逃到了那里。确切说,是((骑))在一位神身上。

English: An' you've never seen a cornered god, have you? <<He frowns.>>##No. Lucky you.
Chinese: 而你从没见过走投无路的神,对吧?<<他皱眉。>>##没有。你真幸运。

English: But we had our engine, the one Cornelius and I had been crewing practically since the start of the whole business.
Chinese: 但我们有我们的机器,从战事一开始,科尼利厄斯和我就几乎一直在操作它。

English: <<He pauses.>> Wait, did I not mention Cornelius? He was my... ah. My commanding officer. Best there ever was. ##He had a real connection to the machine. He and I had flogged that thing through battle after battle, til we knew it almost better than we knew each other.
Chinese: <<他顿了顿。>>等等,我没提过科尼利厄斯吗?他是我的……啊。我的指挥官。史上最好的。##他和那台机器有种真正的联结。他和我驾着那玩意打了一场又一场,直到我们对它的了解,几乎胜过对彼此的了解。

English: Anyway, ah...  <<The old engineer pauses, lost in thought, and his cheeks redden a little beneath the pendulous moustaches.>>
Chinese: 总之,呃……<<老工程师停下话头,陷入沉思,垂坠的八字胡下双颊微微泛红。>>

English: Excuse me. I lost my train of thought for a moment there, I...  Ach. ##You don't need to hear the whole story. It's ancient history, and better that way. I came back, most of us didn't, Cornelius and the war machine included.
Chinese: 失礼了。我一时断了思路,我……唉。##你不必听完整个故事。那是陈年旧事,这样更好。我回来了,我们大多数人没有,科尼利厄斯和那台战争机器也在其中。

English: I imagine he's still there, somewhere; what's ((left)) of him. None of us returned to that place y'see. Even if anyone ((wanted)) to return to that accursed rock, you'd need a [[powerful airship]].
Chinese: 我想他还在那里,某个角落;他((剩下))的部分。你知道,我们谁也没回过那地方。就算有人((想))回那块受诅咒的岩石,你也得有一艘[[强力飞艇]]。

English: <<He sighs.>> Really, what else is there to say?
Chinese: <<他叹息。>>说真的,还有什么好说的?

English: <<An embarrassed silence descends, and you get the feeling that this might have been the most Drangorg has said for some years, and about all he's going to be saying for tonight.>>
Chinese: <<一阵尴尬的沉默降临,你感觉这或许是德兰戈格这些年来最多的一次谈话,也是他今晚打算说的全部了。>>

English: <<Drangorg is silent for a moment, reaching out tentatively, then drawing back, not ready to touch the artifact yet.>>##Is that... ? Did you... ?
Chinese: <<德兰戈格沉默了片刻,试探着伸出手,又缩了回去,还没准备好触碰那件遗物。>>##这是……?你难道……?

English: <<He coughs, producing a particular spectacular flare-up from his pipe, and attempts to compose himself.>> Well, I never thought I would see that again. But you've done a kind thing for an old Greaseguard.##<< He reaches out again, and this time touches the pendant, gently.>>
Chinese: <<他咳嗽起来,烟斗猛地爆出一朵格外壮观的火光,他竭力稳住自己。>>唉,我从没想过还能再见到它。但你为一名老润滑卫队队员做了一件好事。##<<他再次伸出手,这一次,轻轻触碰了那枚坠饰。>>

English: Here. Take this. Don't open it here, not where any old Inquisitor could see! That's void ore. Never built anything with it, never killed anything with it neither, and now I never will, but that's what did for all the gods, that and our own blood and guts.
Chinese: 拿着。收下这个。别在这儿打开,别让任何审判官瞧见!这是虚空矿。我从没用它造过什么,也没用它杀过什么,今后也不会了,但正是这东西送走了所有神明,连同我们自己的血与胆。

English: Little bit of the stuff I kept back for myself at the end of the war, though I can't imagine why. Perhaps to remember it by, but now I have... this.##<<Drangorg is clasping the pendant tightly as he slides a package across to you. Seems like a good time to leave the old man to his thoughts.>>
Chinese: 战争结束时我给自己私留了一小块这东西,虽然我想不明白为什么。也许是为了纪念,但现在我有……这个了。##<<德兰戈格一边把一个包裹推给你,一边紧紧攥着坠饰。看来是时候让老人家独自静一静了。>>

English: Aye. I was a combat engineer. Lieutenant-Artificer Drangorg, 17th Greaseguards. Building and maintaining engines of war the likes of which you couldn't imagine. ##We built machines to take the fight to the gods themselves. And we won.
Chinese: 是啊。我曾是战斗工程师。第十七润滑卫队技师中尉德兰戈格。建造和维修你想象不到的战争机器。##我们造机器,是要跟诸神本人开战。而且我们赢了。

English: <<He frowns.>> Well, I hardly need to tell you it was ((tough.)) Back then, the war effort took everything we ((had.)) By day we worked, and at night - cradled in the cogs an' gears of our machines - we were kept awake by Wikkan screamer-artillery.
Chinese: <<他皱眉。>>嗯,用不着我多说,那段日子((苦得很。))那时,战争吞掉了我们的((一切。))白天我们做工,夜里——蜷在机器的齿轮牙轮之间——维坎人的尖啸炮吵得人无法入睡。

English: But the 17th? We were the ((best)). Most of us were Kardovans - back before the ((Clockwork Kingdom)), or whatever it is now.
Chinese: 但第十七卫队?我们是((最强的))。我们大多是卡尔多瓦人——那还是((发条王国))之前的事,或者说在它如今的模样之前。

English: <<He sighs.>> Most of those lads I never saw again. I heard it's pretty rough over there, with that Clockwork King.
Chinese: <<他叹息。>>那些伙计,大多数我再没见过。听说那边如今挺糟糕,就因为那个发条王。

English: Hm, well, the God War was almost over by the time we got to Aristide's Rock. No place at all, really, but some of them believers fled there with a god. ((On)) a god, in fact.
Chinese: 嗯,我们到亚里士提德之岩时,神之战已近尾声。那地方其实什么都没有,只是一些信徒带着一位神逃到了那里。确切说,是((骑))在一位神身上。

English: But we had our engine, the one Cornelius and I had been crewing practically since the start of the whole business.
Chinese: 但我们有我们的机器,从战事一开始,科尼利厄斯和我就几乎一直在操作它。

English: What is there to say? I came back, most of us didn't - [[Cornelius]] and the war machine included.
Chinese: 还有什么好说的?我回来了,我们大多数人没有——[[科尼利厄斯]]和那台战争机器也在其中。

English: Gods were... well, in the end we discovered that they weren't omnipotent, but they were something damn close. You understand what that means? At best, we were ((playthings)) in their eyes. At best.
Chinese: 神是……嗯,到头来我们发现他们并非全能,但也差不多该死的接近。你明白这意味着什么吗?往最好了说,我们在他们眼里也不过是((玩物))。往最好了说。

English: Say what you like about your local polymath – curse their name, spit in their face. At least if you don't like 'em you can get rid of 'em the usual way. Eye to eye, sword to sword, in an honest election. Or by other means, if it comes to it.
Chinese: 你可以对你们的博学家想说什么就说什么——诅咒他们的名字,啐他们的脸。至少你不喜欢谁,还能用寻常办法除掉他。面对面,剑对剑,来一场公正的选举。或者逼急了,用别的手段。

English: 'Course, I ended up facing more than a few gods eye to eye and sword to sword too, so there you go.
Chinese: 当然啦,到头来我跟不止一位神面对面、剑对剑地干过,你看,就是这么回事。

English: Aye, the Inquisition. Breathing down your neck, trying to see inside your skull. You're not the only one who finds them a little... overbearing.##But look at it from their side. The gods aren't going to just give up and accept their fate. There's no deal they can make with us. For them, it's ((existential)). So they'll never stop trying to take back power. Never.
Chinese: 是啊,宗教裁判所。贴着你的后脖颈呼吸,恨不得看穿你的脑壳。觉得他们有点……盛气凌人的,可不止你一个。##但你也换个角度想想。诸神不会善罢甘休、接受自己的命运。他们和我们没有交易可做。对他们而言,这是((生死存亡))。所以他们夺回权力的尝试永不会停。永远不会。

English: That means every single god, as long as it lives - if you can call what they have "life" -  is a mortal danger to the Union. Especially when any of 'em could grow into a monster if they cozen enough idiots into worshipping 'em.##When you're locked in a cage with a rabid dog, you can't always keep a gentle hand.
Chinese: 这意味着每一个神,只要它还活着——如果那玩意配叫"活"——都是联盟的心腹大患。尤其是,只要有足够的蠢货受骗崇拜它们,任何一个都可能长成怪物。##和疯狗锁在一个笼子里,你没法永远手下留情。

English: Ah, well. Hallowshire's a special case. Things are always messy on the fringe, you know? And some people, truthfully, they like it messy. But some of the other realms... maybe you'll see them sometime.
Chinese: 唉,好吧。哈洛郡是特例。边缘地带总是乱糟糟的,你懂吧?而且说实话,有些人就喜欢乱。但其他一些疆域……也许你哪天能亲眼见识。

English: Take me, I'm from [[Byonne]]. The grapes growing fat before the harvest, the bells ringing in the towns, the markets, the scholars, the songs.##Those are the things we fought for. And we won.
Chinese: 拿我自己说,我来自[[拜昂]]。丰收前饱满的葡萄,小镇上鸣响的钟声,集市,学者,歌谣。##我们为之而战的,就是这些。而且我们赢了。

English: <<He gives you a curt nod.>>
Chinese: <<他朝你生硬地点了点头。>>

English: <<Drangorg gives a quiet nod and puffs his pipe.>>
Chinese: <<德兰戈格轻轻点头,抽了口烟斗。>>

English: Alright then. Anything else?
Chinese: 那行。还有别的吗?

English: Uh... interesting. Have a good day.
Chinese: 呃……有意思。祝你今天愉快。

English: In the field? You... were a soldier?
Chinese: 战地?你……当过兵?

English: What kinds of things, then?
Chinese: 都有些什么样的玩意儿?

English: In the God War, you mean?
Chinese: 你是说神之战?

English: I don't believe I have.
Chinese: 恐怕我没听说过。

English: <<[Lie]>> Of course!
Perhaps some other time.
Chinese: 或许改天吧。

English: Please, go on.
Chinese: 请继续说。

English: I have something for you. <<Give pendant.>>
Chinese: 我有东西给你。<<交出坠饰。>>

English: You never finished telling me about Aristide's Rock.
Chinese: 亚里士提德之岩的事你还没讲完呢。

English: So you fought in the God War, you said?
Chinese: 你说你打过神之战?

English: What was it like in the Greaseguards?
Chinese: 润滑卫队里是什么光景?

English: Tell me again about The Battle for Aristide's Rock.
Chinese: 再给我讲讲亚里士提德之岩之战。

English: What were they like, the Gods?
Chinese: 诸神是什么样子?

English: That's all I wanted to know about the war.
Chinese: 关于那场战争我想知道的就这些了。

English: The Inquisition presence here seems heavy. What do they do around here?
Chinese: 这儿的宗教裁判所势力不小。他们在这附近做什么?

English: Life here seems pretty tough.
Chinese: 这儿的日子似乎相当艰难。

English: Goodbye, Lieutenant-Artificer.
Chinese: 再见,技师中尉。

English: ... Hear that?! That's not cannon-fire! That's the future!...
Chinese: ……听见了吗?!那不是炮火!那是未来!……

English: ... the teeth. The teeth on that thing! The teeth...
Chinese: ……那些牙。那东西的牙!那些牙……

English: ... Gods forgive me. Gods, focus. Focus. Can a God forgive you if you've killed it? Can you forgive a God if it kills you? Can a God kill you if you forgive it? Can you forgive a God if you kill it? Can you kill a God if you forgive it? No! Gods, no. Stop thinking about Gods. Gods. Can you...
Chinese: ……神啊原谅我。神啊,专注。专注。你杀了神,神还会原谅你吗?神杀了你,你能原谅神吗?你原谅了神,神还会杀你吗?你杀了神,你还能原谅神吗?你原谅了神,你还能杀神吗?不!神啊,不。别再想神了。神啊。你能不能……

English: ... Onward! For Apostasy! Death to idols false and true! Death to death itself! Onwards...
Chinese: ……前进!为了背教!让一切偶像,真假皆亡!让死亡本身也亡!前进……

English: ...  Oh, you're scared, are you? Scared of some godling barely born? We'll make it wish it never had been! Come on, lad, does that look like a God to you? I've shat better Gods than that...
Chinese: ……哦,你怕了,是吧?怕一个刚出生的小神?我们会让它后悔来到这世上!来吧,小子,那玩意哪点像神?我拉都比它拉得像神……

English: ... What have we built? What have we done? Bigger than the Gods themselves.##I wonder if we'll be bowing down to it before this war is done...
Chinese: ……我们造了什么?我们干了什么?比诸神本身还大。##我在想,这仗打完之前,我们会不会就得朝它下跪……

English: ... I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home I wanna go home...
Chinese: ……我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家我想回家……

English: ... And how can man die better, than facing fearful odds, for the ashes of his fathers, and the bodies of his Gods?...
Chinese: ……人生怎得壮烈死,莫过直面可怖敌,为护先人骨与灰,为守诸神之遗体……

English: ... the size of it. The abomination! They who claim to throw down idols, only to build this?!...
Chinese: ……它的大小。这可憎之物!口口声声要推倒偶像的人,却造出这么个东西?!……

English: ... the farm. The harvest. The blush on the shroomgills when winter starts to lift. The sound the whetstone on the scythe. The sun on the tops of the trees...
Chinese: ……农场。收成。冬日初退时蘑菇菌褶上的红晕。磨刀石蹭过镰刀的声响。照在树梢上的太阳……

English: ... It's not real. It's going to die like all the others die, and we're going to die with it, like all the others did, and it will all have been a lie and I will never have even known freedom...
Chinese: ……它不是真的。它会像其他神一样死去,我们会陪它一起死,像其他人一样,一切都将是一场谎言,而我甚至从不知道自由为何物……

English: ... my shield, Might my sword, and if I should fall, Gods send me my reward. Strength be my shield, Might my sword, and if I should fall, Gods send me my reward. Strength be my shield, Might my sword, and if I should fall, Gods send me my reward. Strength be my shield, Might my sword, and if I should fall, Gods send me my reward. Strength be my shield, Might my sword, and if I should...
Chinese: ……为吾盾,力量为吾剑,若吾倒下,诸神赐吾报偿。愿力量为吾盾,力量为吾剑,若吾倒下,诸神赐吾报偿。愿力量为吾盾,力量为吾剑,若吾倒下,诸神赐吾报偿。愿力量为吾盾,力量为吾剑,若吾倒下,诸神赐吾报偿。愿力量为吾盾,力量为吾剑,若吾倒下,诸神赐吾……

English: <<A weathered man sits by the window, laboring over each wheezing breath.>>##<<Tattoos of a forgotten outlaw band adorn his neck and hands, blurred with age.>>
Chinese: <<一个饱经风霜的男人坐在窗边,每一次喘息都颇为费力。>>##<<一个被遗忘的法外团伙的纹身,遍布他的脖颈和双手,已随年月模糊。>>

English: <<He looks at you fearfully, then wheezes:>>##I won't tell but... if they come looking for you, I won't hide you.
Chinese: <<他惊恐地看着你,随后喘着气说:>>##我不会说出去,但……要是他们来找你,我也不会藏你。

English: I'm not going to die in that fucking dungeon! Not for anyone! I'm a fucking human being!##<<He spits on the floor, his mucus thick and yellowish.>>
Chinese: 我才不要死在那个该死的地牢里!为了谁都不行!我他妈也是个人!##<<他往地上啐了一口,痰又浓又黄。>>

English: Who do you ((think))? Idiot!
Chinese: 你((猜))是谁?蠢货!

English: It's sick, isn't it? This whole thing.
Chinese: 很恶心,对吧?这一整摊子事。

English: You again? <<He wheezes.>>##Make yourself at home.
Chinese: 又是你?<<他喘着气。>>##别拘束,就当自己家。

English: I should never have taken this job all those years ago.##<<He begins coughing violently.>>
Chinese: 那么多年前,我就不该接这活。##<<他开始剧烈咳嗽。>>

English: I should never have taken this job.
Chinese: 我就不该接这活。

English: She's just like me, you know?##The mushrooms are growing, and her body can't fight them.
Chinese: 她和我一样,你知道吗?##蘑菇在生长,而她的身体挡不住它们。

English: It kills you slow. Let me tell you.
Chinese: 这东西杀人是慢性的。听我一句。

English: Those [[bastards]] brought the mushrooms here a long time ago.##They infected The Mollusc because it was useful to them.
Chinese: 那些天杀的[[混蛋]]很久以前就把蘑菇带来了。##他们感染软体,是因为它对他们有用。

English: Over the span of a generation, the mycelium spread while the Coven declined. And now it's completely out of their control. Everything outside their castle is falling apart.
Chinese: 一代人的时间里,菌丝蔓延,而魔团衰落。如今事态完全失控了。城堡外的一切都在崩坏。

English: The Mollusc really is just like me though. One day soon she's going to be gone forever. And you know what? The fanatical dreams that were built on her back will die with her!
Chinese: 不过软体真的和我一样。用不了多久,她就会永远消逝。你猜怎么着?那些压在她背上筑起的狂热美梦,都会随她一起完蛋!

English: <<His passion exceeds him, and another coughing fit ensues. By the time he recovers, he seems to have lost his train of thought.>>
Chinese: <<他一时激动过了头,又引发一阵咳嗽。等他缓过来,似乎已经忘了刚才说到哪儿了。>>

English: It was a long time ago now. They told me it was manual labor, but the type that gets you hanged by the inquisition. They didn't tell me the location or the client, and I'd never heard of the [[Coven of the Mollusc.]].##Supposedly, all I had to do was get on an airship, do the work, not ask questions, take the money, go home and shut the fuck up about it forever.
Chinese: 那已经是很久以前的事了。他们说就是体力活,不过是那种会被宗教裁判所绞死的体力活。他们没说地点,没说雇主,我也从没听说过[[软体魔团]]。##照他们的说法,我要做的就是上飞艇,干活,别多问,拿钱,回家,然后永远闭紧鸟嘴。

English: Easy money, I thought. No thieving, no kidnapping, no murder. For an outlaw like me that's about as regular as work gets. And the pay was nice too.##<<He coughs, clutching his abdomen in pain.>>
Chinese: 我当时想,轻省钱。不偷不抢不杀人。对我这种法外之徒来说,这活儿再正当不过了。报酬还不赖。##<<他咳嗽着,痛苦地捂住腹部。>>

English: Well, long story short, I fucked up. Nothing here is free. I got into debt and couldn't leave.##I came so close to paying it off, but my body started to deteriorate, and I started making less and less money.
Chinese: 唉,长话短说,我把事情搞砸了。这儿没什么是免费的。我背上了债,走不了了。##我差一点就还清了,可我的身体开始垮掉,挣的钱越来越少。

English: Now Im so deep in the hole, I might as well be buried in it.##Not that I have long to live anyway.
Chinese: 如今我陷得太深,跟埋在坑里没两样。##反正我也活不了多久了。

English: <<He squints at you.>>##Mining, I guess you could call it?
Chinese: <<他眯眼看你。>>##采矿吧,你大概会这么叫?

English: The Mollusc produces [[shroomweave ore]] deep in its womb. That's what the Coven is here for.##My work was to move heavy shit around so this could happen.
Chinese: 软体在它的腹腔深处产出[[菌织矿]]。魔团守在这儿就是为了这个。##我的活儿就是搬重物,好让这事成真。

English: Sometimes I'd help cut away some flesh where it wasn't wanted, or graft a piece of somewhere else. Everything was so large it took a team of three or four to do anything.##<<His voice begins to go hoarse from talking so quickly, and he lets out a deep cough.>>
Chinese: 有时我帮忙切除多余的血肉,或者把别处的移植过来。东西都太大了,干什么都得三四个人一组。##<<他说得太急,嗓音开始沙哑,发出一阵深沉的咳嗽。>>

English: I dreamed about it, but... they control every airship, check every detail... and if the Coven caught me I'd be...##<<He coughs violently. You wonder if he is going to throw up.>>
Chinese: 我梦到过逃走,但是……他们控制着每一艘飞艇,核查每一个细节……要是被魔团抓到,我就……##<<他咳嗽得厉害。你担心他会不会吐出来。>>

English: Oh, you're... going already?
Chinese: 哦,你这就……要走了?

English: Fair Enough.
Chinese: 也好。

English: Why not!?
Chinese: 为什么不行!?

English: If ((who)) comes looking?
Chinese: 要是((谁))来找?

English: What do you know about The Mollusc?
Chinese: 关于软体你知道些什么?

English: What was the job?
Chinese: 那是什么活?

English: What kind of work were you doing?
Chinese: 你干的什么工种?

English: Did you ever try to escape?
Chinese: 你试过逃跑吗?

English: I see...
Chinese: 我明白了……

English: Goodbye
Chinese: 再见
